page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The server includes 96.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Cache specifications comprise 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB L3 cache. Supported CPU features include AVX, AVX-512, AES, FMA, BMI2, and ADX instructions, running on a KVM hypervisor. The instance has no local storage and no GPU accelerators, while providing an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, single-core CPU throughput registers in the lower quartile, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core result of 1107.98 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1008.0. Multi-core performance falls into middle-tier averages, achieving 17544.06 on stress-ng multi-core and 7786.0 on Geekbench multi-core. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate 986.24 GB/sec for small cached blocks, tapering to 90.15 GB/sec read and 50.79 GB/sec write for uncached 256MB blocks. Software compilation via Clang scored 14646.0 on Geekbench, while Redis SET operations yielded 16.81 million operations per second and static web serving throughput reached 13.07 GB/sec. Small 135M model LLM inference generation achieved 75.32 tokens/sec, whereas medium 7B model generation recorded 10.18 tokens/sec.

The hardware configuration displays a efficiency tradeoff between modest single-threaded execution speeds and balanced multi-core density. Without integrated local NVMe storage or specialized hardware acceleration, overhead remains dedicated to network access and general system memory allocations. This resource allocation makes ecs.g5.6xlarge functional for static web serving, Redis caching nodes, software build environments, and intermediate enterprise applications requiring a standard compute-to-memory baseline.

Operating on a KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture at 2.5 GHz, it offers 4.0 GB of memory per vCPU alongside AVX-512 instruction support. Network capabilities include an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth, with zero local storage and no dedicated GPUs. Benchmark results show lower-tier single-threaded CPU speed paired with average multi-threaded scaling, memory bandwidth, and static web serving throughput. It processes Redis SET calls at 16.81 million operations per second and achieves moderate LLM prompt processing speeds on smaller models. Given its balanced resource distribution, ecs.g5.6xlarge is suited for containerized application hosting, caching tiers, software compilation pipelines, and middle-tier web servers.
